title: Secure Social Login with Token Persistence
description: As a Reader, I want to sign in using my existing Google or Apple account so that I can securely access my personal library across devices without managing a new password.
business_value: Reduces registration friction (increasing acquisition) and ensures secure identity management via Auth0, protecting user data and facilitating personalized experiences.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful Login with Social Provider","given":"The user is on the login screen and has a valid Google/Apple account","when":"The user taps the 'Sign in with Google' button and authorizes the app","then":"The app authenticates via Auth0, retrieves a secure JWT, stores it in the device's secure storage (Keychain/Keystore), and redirects to the Dashboard."},{"scenario":"Session Persistence","given":"The user has previously logged in and closed the app","when":"The user re-launches the app","then":"The app retrieves the stored token, validates it silently, and bypasses the login screen."},{"scenario":"Token Refresh Failure","given":"The user's session has expired (401 Unauthorized from API)","when":"The app attempts to refresh the token via Auth0 and fails","then":"The user is logged out, local data is cleared or locked, and the Login screen is presented."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-003: Implement Auth Screens & Social Login","WI-BE-002: Implement Auth0 JWT Authentication & Authorization"]
definition_of_done: ["Login works on both iOS and Android simulators","JWT is stored in flutter_secure_storage","Backend validates tokens correctly","Unit tests for auth logic pass"]

title: Book Search and Library Addition with Resilient Proxy
description: As a Reader, I want to search for books by title or author and add them to my library so that I can organize my reading list and track my progress.
business_value: Core functionality enabling the primary use case. The backend proxy ensures API key security and resilience against external API failures (Google Books).
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Search and Add Book","given":"The user is on the Add Book screen","when":"The user types a query and selects a book from the results","then":"The book details are saved to the local database, synced to the backend, and appear in the user's Library list."},{"scenario":"Free Tier Limit Enforcement","given":"A Free tier user already has 20 books in their library","when":"The user attempts to add a 21st book","then":"The system prevents the addition and displays an upgrade prompt."},{"scenario":"External API Resilience","given":"The Google Books API is experiencing downtime (500 errors)","when":"The user searches for a book","then":"The backend Circuit Breaker opens, and the user receives a graceful error message suggesting manual entry."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-004: Implement Library & Book Search UI","WI-BE-003: Implement Library Module (Google Books Proxy)"]
definition_of_done: ["Search debouncing implemented","Infinite scroll works for library list","Circuit breaker policies configured in backend","Limit logic unit tested"]

title: Offline-First Reading Session Tracking
description: As a Commuter, I want to log reading sessions and use the timer even when offline so that I can track my habits without interruption during travel.
business_value: Critical UX requirement for mobile apps. Ensures data integrity and usability regardless of network conditions, increasing user engagement.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Offline Session Logging","given":"The device has no internet connection","when":"The user logs a reading session","then":"The session is saved to the local Isar database and marked as 'dirty' (unsynced)."},{"scenario":"Background Synchronization","given":"The user has unsynced local data","when":"The device regains internet connectivity","then":"The background sync worker pushes changes to the backend API using batch processing."},{"scenario":"Timer Persistence","given":"The user starts a reading timer","when":"The app is killed or goes to the background","then":"The timer state (start time) is persisted, and the correct elapsed time is shown when the app is reopened."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-MOB-002: Implement Local Database (Isar) & Sync Engine","WI-MOB-005: Implement Tracking & Timer UI","WI-BE-004: Implement Tracking Module with Sync Logic"]
definition_of_done: ["Isar schemas defined and migrated","Sync logic handles conflict resolution (last-write-wins)","Background worker handles network state changes","Timer logic robust against app kill"]
